target.title: Improve Kimi K2 credential errors
target.body:
## Summary

- trim Kimi K2 API keys before constructing the Authorization header
- classify HTTP 401 and 403 as invalid credentials instead of generic API failures
- add an actionable invalid-or-expired credential message
- add deterministic request and status mapping coverage through an injected transport

## Production-path proof

A temporary executable linked against `CodexBarCore` called the public fetcher with a 401 fixture:

```text
authorization=Bearer fixture
result=invalidCredentials
```

The temporary target was removed after the run. No live credentials were used.

## Testing

- `swift test --disable-sandbox --filter KimiK2UsageFetcherTests` (8 passed)
- `make check` (SwiftFormat clean; SwiftLint 0 violations; final host cache plist write blocked by sandbox permissions)
- `git diff --check`
